full_details: You were at the lodging all day. In the morning the king was off the wall, and the ground still had no speech. You ate at threepence. The loaf was a penny, a finger and a half short, and it was not weighed. You said there is no fool in this play, and that you have not told Kemp. Gib stayed on the open chronicle. Field's book is still in the house. After dinner you wrote three sentences. The king is come down. The lords look at his hands. He looks at the ground. You did not write a glass, and you did not write the room. At night you set down what Henslowe said. Six pound, and he never argues the jig. The money was not wasted. You did not price their house.
one_sentence: You brought him off the wall, ate the short loaf, and wrote three sentences in which he looks at the ground.
title: The king is come down
